fusions.name: Close Ranks
fusions.desc: Fires a round that deals 7 damage, 10% more for each ally near you (max +40%). It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Rallying Blast
fusions.desc: Fires a broad blast ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to everything in it. If it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Pass the Cartridges
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Rested Aim
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
